llm_response.reason: The site displays key scam characteristics: it asks users to access via a wallet application, suggesting interaction with cryptocurrency wallets which is a common phishing/scam method. Domain registration is extremely recent and registrant info is vague or missing (no real company or business contact listed). There is no product, company info, nor legitimate business details. The singular, minimalistic message uses a psychological tactic to direct users to act. All these are common among scam cryptocurrency/phishing sites.
